{"final":"The `get_extension` function in `src/pathutil.py` incorrectly handles compound file extensions (e.g., `.tar.gz`) because it uses `os.path.splitext`, which only splits the extension from the last dot. 1. For a file named `archive.tar.gz`, `os.path.splitext` returns `('archive.tar', '.gz')`, resulting in the extension `.gz` instead of `.tar.gz`. 2. To fix this, the function should be updated to handle known compound extensions or use a loop to strip multiple extensions if the business logic requires the full compound suffix."}
